card.name: "the" before religious orders and groups
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "founder of", "Provincial of" or "member of", where a named religious order or society comes next (Society of Jesus, Jesuits, Congregation). Weaker on a few other words that begin a name or term.

modes.label: Religious order names
modes.description: "the" after "founder of", "member of" or "joined" just before a named order or group.
modes.example: Ignatius Loyola, founder of<< the>> Society of Jesus.

modes.label: Odd scattered cases
modes.description: Words partway into a longer term, such as "deep" in a vein phrase or the start of an acronym.
modes.example: slow intravenous infusion in a central or<< deep>> vein in adults

card.plain: It fires on "the" when a religious order or society name is about to follow, such as the Jesuits.
